title: New values of the largest Littlewood-Richardson coefficient via iterated Okounkov compression

creators.name: Ruiz Loera, Andre
creators.affiliation: Department of Mathematics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

description: Computes the largest Littlewood-Richardson coefficient C(n) exactly for n = 46 to 53, extending the Pak-Soskin computation that stops at n = 45, via an exact search-space reduction obtained by iterating the Okounkov averaging step. This record contains the manuscript (paper.pdf, 9 pages), its LaTeX source, and the complete code and logs reproducing every numerical claim. The code is licensed MIT.
